verses.text: 392. Scripture speaks of a sin of these angels. (Cf. 2 Pet 2:4.) This “fall” consists in the free choice of these created spirits, who radically and irrevocably rejected God and his reign. We find a reflection of that rebellion in the tempter’s words to our first parents: “You will be like God.” (Gen 3:5.) The devil “has sinned from the beginning”; he is “a liar and the father of lies”. (1 Jn 3:8; Jn 8:44.)
